title: Program Optimization & Evaluation
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for optimizing and evaluating DSPy programs. It includes various teleprompters for automated prompt engineering and few-shot example selection, alongside a suite of metrics for robust program performance assessment.

nodes.label: Optimize DSPy Programs
nodes.title: DSPy Program Optimizers
nodes.description: Contains various teleprompters (optimizers) for automated prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and fine-tuning strategies to improve DSPy program performance.

nodes.label: Evaluate Program Performance
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Provides a suite of metrics for evaluating DSPy programs, including traditional exact-match scores and advanced LLM-based metrics for semantic F1, completeness, and groundedness.

nodes.label: Propose Program Instructions
nodes.title: DSPy Program Proposers
nodes.description: Offers tools for analyzing datasets and programs, generating observations, and proposing optimized instructions for individual modules to enhance prompt quality.

nodes.label: Provide Optimization Utilities
nodes.title: DSPy Optimization Utilities
nodes.description: Contains helper functions for monitoring and evaluating program optimization trials, including execution history inspection, token usage logging, and quality calculation.

groups.label: Optimization Strategies
groups.title: Core Optimization Strategies
groups.description: Modules dedicated to developing and applying various strategies for improving DSPy program performance, from prompt engineering to instruction generation.

groups.label: Evaluation & Support
groups.title: Evaluation & Utility Support
groups.description: Components providing the necessary metrics and utility functions to measure, monitor, and analyze the effectiveness of DSPy program optimizations.
